name: webyansh-a11y-components
description: Webflow code components for the Accessibility & Compliance Suite. Published to the Webyansh Workspace via DevLink.

overrides: Transitive advisories in @webflow/webflow-cli. Dev-only — the CLI publishes the
library, it is never part of the component bundle shipped to visitors.
adm-zip <0.6.0: 4GB allocation from a crafted ZIP.
form-data <4.0.6: CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field names.
undici <7.29.0: nine advisories incl. TLS validation bypass and cache disclosure.
KNOWN UNFIXABLE: elliptic <=6.6.1 (low, risky crypto primitive). 6.6.1 IS latest,
so no patched version exists. Dev-only and not reachable from published output.
